blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.
blocks.zh: 最近全复式的语音对话模型可以同时进行听和说话,但是精细的刻度模型仍然在每个交互框架中自动推进骨干. 我们引入了DiffuPlex,这是一个滚动的蒙面扩散框架,通过在单一主干后预测多个未来的用户和助理帧来减少这种顺序计算. DiffuPlex只消耗每个预测未来的自信前缀,而互动则继续按原帧速率进行. 随着用户语音的到来,它检查相应的用户预测,当交互时,保留已经播放的助手内容,同时只修订未播放的未来. 我们考虑在同一预测器上的两个推论政策:DiffuPlex-LISTEN在预测助手沉默时会消耗多个未来帧,而DiffuPlex-SPEAK也可以消耗预测的助手语音. DiffuPlex在全方位互动和口语评价中大量减少连续主干计算,同时在很大程度上保持互动行为和一般能力。 DiffuPlex-LISTEN和DiffuPlex-SPEAK实现1.46\时间和1.59\时间部署-路径墙点速度,1.61\时间和1.80\时间 核心LM加速,所有测量到的主干引用在80ms交互间隔内完成. 人类评价显示,Listen保留了语音自然和对话质量,而SPEAK保留了语音质量,在语音自然性上有一定的退化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
With the advent of large language models (LLMs) ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) , voice assistants have shifted from cascaded pipelines of automatic speech recognition (ASR), text processing, and text-to-speech (TTS) ( Lin et al., 2024 ) toward end-to-end speech LLMs that directly take speech as input and generate speech as output ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2024 ) .
Most early systems remain half-duplex: the user and model take turns, and response generation begins only after the user is judged to have finished speaking ( Silero Team, 2024 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
Human conversation, however, includes interruptions, overlap, and backchannels.
This has motivated full-duplex spoken dialog models that continuously listen while generating speech, allowing both sides to speak and respond even when their speech overlaps ( Défossez et al., 2024 ; Roy et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
随着大型语言模型(LLMs)的出现(OpenAI, 2026;Quu等, 2026),语音助理已经从自动语音识别(ASR),文本处理,以及文本对语音(TTS)(Lin等, 2024)的分级管道转向直接将语音作为输入并生成语音作为输出的端到端语音(Zhang等, 2023;Kim等, 2024;Fang等, 2025;Zeng等, 2024).
大多数早期系统仍为半复数:用户和模型轮流进行,只有在用户被判断完成演讲后才开始响应生成(Silero Team,2024;Liao等,2025;Li等,2026a.).
然而,人类对话包括中断、重叠和后通道。
这激发了全方位的口语对话模式,这些模式在生成语音的同时不断倾听,允许双方说话和回应,即使其语音重叠(Défossez等,2024;Roy等,2026;Kim等,2026;Cui等,2026).

Figure 1: Overview of conventional full-duplex generation and DiffuPlex.
Conventional models advance one interaction frame at a time, requiring a new backbone computation at every step (left).
DiffuPlex predicts multiple future frames in a single backbone wake, consumes a retained prefix, and revises only the unplayed future when new user input diverges from the prediction (right).
blocks.zh:
图 1:常规全复式生成和DiffuPlex的概述.
常规模型一次推进一个交互框架,需要每个步骤(左)都进行新的主干计算.
DiffuPlex在单个骨干后钟中预测出多个未来帧,会消耗一个被保留的前缀,当新的用户输入偏离了预测时只修改了未播放的未来(右).

blocks.en:
Despite enabling continuous interaction, full-duplex models remain fundamentally autoregressive.
Some serialize user and assistant speech into a single sequence and update relatively coarse chunks ( Veluri et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , while multi-stream models keep parallel user and assistant channels and update both at every interaction step ( Défossez et al., 2024 ; Roy et al., 2026 ; Ohashi et al., 2026 ) .
This finer granularity enables prompt reactions to interruptions, overlaps, and backchannels, but increases backbone computation.
Moshi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) and PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) , for example, process one frame every 80ms, requiring a new temporal-backbone forward pass every 80ms throughout the conversation.
blocks.zh:
尽管能够持续地进行互动,但完全复杂的模式仍然从根本上具有自相递减性。
有的将用户和助手的语音序列化为单个序列并更新相对粗糙的块(Veluri等,2024;Zhang等,2025;Cui等,2026;Kim等,2026;多流模式保持用户和助手的平行通道,并在每个互动步骤上同时更新(Défossez等,2024;Roy等,2026;Ohashi等,2026).
这种更细细的颗粒能使中断,重叠和回通道迅速反应,但能增加骨干计算.
Moshi (Défossez等, 2024)和PersonaPlex (Roy等, 2026) 例如,每80米处理一个帧, 需要一个新的时间-后骨向前传递每80米整个对话.

blocks.en:
Fine-grained interaction, however, does not necessarily require a fresh backbone computation at every frame.
Across 38h of Switchboard dyadic telephone conversations ( Godfrey et al., 1992 ) , 95.3% of active conversational time contains only one speaking participant ( Levinson and Torreira, 2015 ) , leaving long stretches in which the other side remains silent.
Even during speech, upcoming content is planned beyond individual frames: response preparation can begin before the interlocutor finishes speaking ( Barthel et al., 2017 ) , and speech planning can extend beyond individual words ( Martin et al., 2010 ) .
These observations suggest that several future interaction frames may be predicted together.
Text generation has exploited similar redundancy through speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) and diffusion language models ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Arriola et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) .
However, extending such parallel prediction to full-duplex speech is challenging because the future user speech needed to verify the assistant draft has not yet arrived.
blocks.zh:
然而,精细的相互作用不一定需要在每个框架进行新的骨干计算。
横跨38h的Switchboard dyadic电话交谈(Godfrey等,1992年),95.3%的活跃对话时间只包含一名演讲参与者(Levinson和Torreira,2015年),留下了很长的伸展期,对方对此保持沉默.
即便在演讲期间,即将到来的内容被计划超越了单个框架:在对话者完成演讲前(Barthel等,2017年),响应准备可以开始,而演讲规划可以超越单个词(Martin等,2010年).
这些意见表明,今后可以一起预测若干互动框架。
文本生成通过投机解码(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023)和传播语言模型(Nie等,2025;Arriola等,2025;Fu等,2026)利用了类似的冗余。
然而,将这种平行预测扩大到完全繁复的演讲具有挑战性,因为核查助理草稿所需的未来用户演讲尚未到来。

blocks.en:
We introduce DiffuPlex , which replaces frame-by-frame autoregressive rollout with masked prediction of a short future block.
At each temporal-backbone forward pass, which we call a backbone wake , DiffuPlex predicts a block of future user and assistant frames by replacing unavailable future inputs with learned MASK tokens.
It retains a confident contiguous prefix of the assistant draft and plays it at the original interaction rate while user speech continues to arrive.
The user predictions are stored for consistency checking.
If the observed user input diverges from the prediction, DiffuPlex keeps all assistant frames that have already been played and revises only the remaining future.
Figure 1 illustrates this process of predicting a future block and revising its unplayed portion as the interaction unfolds.
We refer to this repeated process of predicting, consuming, and revising a masked future as rolling masked diffusion .
blocks.zh:
我们介绍DiffuPlex,它用对短短未来块的蒙面预测取代了逐帧自动推出.
DiffuPlex通过用学习到的MASK令牌来取代无法提供的未来输入,
它保留了助理草稿的自信相接的前缀,并在用户语音继续到来时以原始交互速率播放.
用户预测被存储用于一致性检查.
如果观察到的用户输入与预测有差异,DiffuPlex会保留所有已经播放过的助手帧,仅修改所剩的未来.
图1说明了随着互动的展开,预测未来块并修订其未播放部分的过程。
我们提到这个反复预测、消耗和修改被掩盖的未来的过程,

blocks.en:
We evaluate DiffuPlex on full-duplex interaction, spoken-language capability, human evaluation, and inference efficiency.
We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex- Listen consumes multiple future frames only when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex- Speak can also consume predicted assistant speech.
On Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0, the two policies advance the interaction by 1.91 and 2.23 frames per backbone wake on average while remaining close to the autoregressive backbone in interaction behavior.
On the fixed 60-clip runtime subset, they achieve 1.46 × \times and 1.59 × \times deployment-path wall-clock speedups and 1.61 × \times and 1.80 × \times Core LM speedups, with all measured invocations completing within 80ms.
The more conservative Listen policy also preserves human-rated speech and conversational quality, while extending prediction into assistant speech exposes a speech-quality trade-off that we analyze further.
To test whether speedups can be achieved without future prediction, we compare against training-free baselines that defer autoregressive execution and emit silence on skipped frames, at the cost of degraded full-duplex conversational dynamics.
DiffuPlex instead predicts the intervening interaction, reducing backbone calls while better preserving these dynamics.
blocks.zh:
我们评价DiffuPlex的全复式互动、口语能力、人的评价和推论效率。
我们认为对同一预测器有两种推论政策: DiffuPlex-Listen只有在预测助理沉默时才会消耗多个未来帧,而DiffuPlex-Speak也可以消耗预测的助理语音.
在"Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0"上,两项政策平均以每根骨干1.91和2.23帧来推进互动,同时在互动行为上保持与自递性骨干相近.
在固定的60-clip运行时间子集上,它们实现1.46×分时和1.59×分时部署-路径墙-时速快取和1.61×分时和1.80×分时. 核心LM加速,所有测量到的引用在80ms内完成.
比较保守的听政政策也保留了人分的言论和对话质量,同时将预测延伸至助理言论暴露出一种我们进一步分析的言论质量取舍.
为了测试能否在没有未来预测的情况下实现速度,我们比较了无训练基线,这些基线推迟了自回执行,并在被跳出的框架上释放出沉默,而代价则是退化了的完全复杂的对话动态。
DiffuPlex转而预测了介入的相互作用,减少了骨干调用,同时更好地维护了这些动态.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models. Early work such as dGSLM ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ) jointly modeled two conversational speech streams to capture turn-taking and overlap.
More recent end-to-end full-duplex models use either single-stream generation, as in SyncLLM ( Veluri et al., 2024 ) , OmniFlatten ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Raon-SpeechChat ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , and MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , or parallel user and assistant streams, as in Moshi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) and PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) .
Recent work further improves turn-taking, interruption handling, and response timing through interactivity training ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Hsiao et al., 2026 ; Ohashi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
Despite these advances, these models still advance the interaction autoregressively, requiring sequential backbone computation as new frames or chunks are generated.
blocks.zh:
Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models. (原始内容存档于2018-09-27). dGSLM等早期作品(Nguyen等,2023年)联合模拟了两条对话语音流来捕捉取取回转和重叠.
较近期的端到端全复式模型使用任意一流生成,如SyncLLM(Veluri等人,2024年),OmniFlatten。 (张等,2025年),Raon-SpeechChat (Kim等,2026年),和MiniCPM-o 4.5 (Cui等,2026年),或相平行的用户和助手流,如Moshi (Défossez等,2024年)和PersonaPlex (Roy等,2026年).
近期的工作通过互动培训进一步改善了轮转、中断处理和反应时间安排(Wu等,2025;Hsiao等,2026;Ohashi等,2026;Li等,2026b)。
尽管取得了这些进步,这些模型仍然自动地推进了相互作用,随着新框架或块的产生,需要相继进行骨干计算.

blocks.en:
Accelerating Autoregressive Generation. Speculative and parallel decoding reduce sequential generation by predicting multiple future tokens and processing them with fewer target-model calls ( Stern et al., 2018 ; Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) .
Methods such as Medusa ( Cai et al., 2024 ) and EAGLE ( Li et al., 2024 ) improve drafting through additional prediction heads or feature-level prediction, and related approaches have been extended to autoregressive speech generation ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Yanuka et al., 2026 ) .
PredGen ( Li and Grover, 2025 ) and RelayS2S ( Mai and Liang, 2026 ) instead begin response generation before the complete spoken input is available, using partial user speech to prepare future output while subsequent input continues to arrive.
However, their speculative responses remain autoregressively generated.
They therefore move response computation earlier rather than reducing the sequential backbone steps required to predict multiple future interaction frames within an end-to-end full-duplex model.
blocks.zh:
加快自动递减生成. 分型和相平行的解码通过预测多个未来符来减少相继生成,并以较少的目标模型调用处理(Stern等,2018;Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023.).
美杜莎等方法 (Cai等人,2024年)和EAGLE(Li等人,2024年)通过增加预测头或地物水平预测改进了起草工作,相关方法被推广到自回式语音生成(Nguyen等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年a;Yanuka等人,2026年).
PredGen (Li and Grover, 2025)和RelayS2S (Mai and Liang, 2026)转而在完整的口语输入之前开始响应生成,在后续输入持续到来的同时使用部分用户语音来准备未来的输出.
然而,它们的投机反应仍然自发地产生。
因此,它们更早地移动了响应计算,而不是减少在端到端的全复式模型中预测多个未来互动框架所需的相继骨干步骤.

blocks.en:
Diffusion-Based Parallel Generation. Masked and block diffusion replace token-by-token generation with parallel prediction over multiple positions ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Arriola et al., 2025 ) .
Recent work adapts pretrained autoregressive models to masked or block prediction ( Gong et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Gat et al., 2025 ; Samragh et al., 2025 ) ,
while DFlash (Chen et al., 2026a) and DiffuSpec (Li et al., 2026a) use diffusion models as parallel
drafters for autoregressive verification.
Rolling Diffusion Models ( Ruhe et al., 2024 ) and Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) further consider causal or rolling prediction over temporal sequences.
Related ideas have recently been applied to speech: VocalNet-MDM ( Cheng et al., 2026b ) accelerates streaming half-duplex speech LLMs, while Chatterbox-Flash ( Seo et al., 2026 ) and DELTA-TTS ( Moon et al., 2026 ) adapt autoregressive TTS models for block or masked diffusion.
In these settings, farther output positions can be predicted from already available input.
Full-duplex dialog introduces a different constraint: future assistant frames depend on user speech that has not yet arrived.
DiffuPlex therefore predicts the missing future interaction jointly and revises only the unplayed assistant future as the corresponding user speech is observed.
blocks.zh:
以传播为基础的平行生成。 面罩和块状扩散用多处位置的平行预测取代了逐个代号(Austin等,2021;Lou等,2024;Sahoo等,2024;Arriola等,2025)。
最近的工作调整了预先训练的自递模型,以掩盖或阻挡预测(龚等,2025;程等,2026a; Wu等人,2026年;Gat等人,2025年;Samragh等人,2025年),
当 DFlash 时 (Chen等人,2026a)和DiffuSpec(Li等人,2026a)将扩散模型作为平行使用
用于自递性核查的起草器。
滚动扩散模型(Ruhe等,2024年)和扩散强化模型(Chen等,2024年)进一步审议了时间序列上的因果关系或滚动预测.
相关想法最近被应用于演讲:VocalNet-MDM (Cheng等,2026b)加速流出半复式语音LLMS,而Chatterbox-Flash(Seo等,2026)和DELTA-TTS(Moon等,2026)则为块或被遮住的传播而自旋TTS模型.
在这些环境中,可以从已有的投入中预测更远的产出位置。
Full-duplex 对话框引入了不同的制约:未来的助手框架依赖于尚未到来的用户语音.
DiffuPlex因此共同预测了未来缺失的交互功能,并随着对应的用户语音的被观察,只修改了未玩的助手未来.

blocks.en: 3 DiffuPlex
blocks.zh: 3 个 DiffuPlex

blocks.en:
We introduce DiffuPlex , an approach for reducing sequential temporal-backbone calls in full-duplex spoken dialog models.
We build on personaplex-rl-seamless ( Ohashi et al., 2026 ) , which operates at 12.5Hz, or one interaction frame every 80ms.
At each frame, its temporal backbone jointly predicts the user and assistant streams, requiring one backbone call per frame.
Backbone details are in Appendix C.1 .
DiffuPlex instead predicts a short masked future at each backbone call, which we refer to as a backbone wake .
As in Figure 2 , each wake produces an assistant draft together with user predictions over the same future interval.
DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of the draft and revises only the unplayed future when newly arriving user input is inconsistent with the stored user predictions.
We call this repeated predict-consume-revise process rolling masked diffusion , as successive masked-future predictions roll forward with the evolving interaction boundary.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍DiffuPlex, 一种在全复式口语对话模式中减少相继时间后骨调用的方法。
我们利用无人缝(Ohashi等,2026年),每80米运行12.5Hz或一个互动框架。
在每个帧中,其时间主干线共同预测用户和助手流,需要每个帧一个主干线呼叫.
后骨的细节见附录C.1。
DiffuPlex则预测每个主干电话都有一个被遮住的短暂未来,
如图2所示,每个后钟都制作一个助理草稿,并附有用户对未来同一间隔的预测。
DiffuPlex只消耗草稿的自信前缀,在新到来的用户输入与存储的用户预测不一致时只修改未玩的未来.
我们称这种反复的预测 - 假设 - 重温过程 滚动的遮掩扩散, 随着不断演变的相互作用边界, 连续的遮掩未来预测。

blocks.en: 3.1 Masked Future Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.1 蒙面的未来预测

blocks.en:
Predicting several future interaction frames in one backbone wake is difficult because farther positions depend on assistant outputs that have not yet been generated and user input that has not yet arrived.
DiffuPlex replaces these inputs with learned stream-specific MASK tokens.
At each wake, it predicts W W future positions indexed by lookahead h ∈ { 1 , … , W } h\in\{1,\ldots,W\} , where h = 1 h=1 is the ordinary next-frame autoregressive prediction and larger h h denotes farther future positions.
As h h increases, additional streams become unavailable and are masked according to their roles and native delays.
The exact 17-stream layout is shown in Figure 4 in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh:
今后很难在一个主干线之后预测若干互动框架,因为其他职位取决于尚未产生的助理产出和尚未到达的用户输入。
DiffuPlex将这些输入替换为学习到的流特定的MASK符号.
在每个时刻,它都会预测W W 未来位置的指数化为: lookahead h {{1,.,W} h\in\1,\ldots,W\},其中h = 1 h=1是普通的下帧自旋预测,而更大的h 表示更远的未来位置.
随着hh的增多,其他溪流变得无法使用,并且根据它们的角色和本土的延误被掩盖.
17个流的确切布局见附录C.3图4。

blocks.en:
To reflect the variable number of frames advanced between backbone wakes at inference time, we divide the training dialog into consecutive blocks with lengths L blk L_{\mathrm{blk}} sampled uniformly from { 1 , … , W } \{1,\ldots,W\} .
Lookahead resets to h = 1 h=1 at the start of each block.
Following the clean-context construction of block diffusion ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , we concatenate a clean copy of the sequence with a masked copy tiled by these variable-length blocks.
Each masked block conditions on the realized clean context preceding it and predicts a fresh future from that point in the interaction.
blocks.zh:
为了反映主干线在推断时钟之间前进的可变帧数,我们把训练对话框分出相接的块,长度为L blk L_{\mathrm{blk}}},从{1,.,W}}\1,\ldots,W\}.
在每个区块的起始处将 Lookahead 重排为 h = 1 h = 1 。
在区块扩散(Arriola等,2025年)的清洁成文后,我们用由这些可变长区块所活化而成的口罩式的复制品,将序列的清洁成册.
每一个隐蔽的块状条件在它之前的已实现的清洁环境上,并预示着从这个互动点开始的新未来.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of DiffuPlex.
(a) One backbone wake predicts a masked future block with an assistant draft and user predictions.
The staircase indicates stream-wise masking of inputs unavailable at that wake; the exact 17-stream layout is shown in Figure 4 in Appendix C.3 .
(b) A confident prefix is played at the original 80ms rate without additional backbone wakes, while incoming user frames can trigger revision of only the unplayed future.
blocks.zh:
图2:DiffuPlex概览.

All lookaheads are processed in the same temporal-backbone pass, while the depth transformer remains autoregressive over the audio codebooks within each frame.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use personaplex-rl-seamless ( Ohashi et al., 2026 ) , a reinforcement-learning post-trained variant of PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) , as the backbone for DiffuPlex.
We freeze the original backbone and train only the stream-specific MASK embeddings and future-gated LoRA parameters on Seamless Interaction ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) , a large-scale dataset of face-to-face dyadic interactions.
Unless otherwise noted, we use a maximum lookahead of W = 16 W=16 , a confidence threshold of τ conf = 0.80 \tau_{\mathrm{conf}}=0.80 , and a revision threshold of τ rev = − 0.5 \tau_{\mathrm{rev}}=-0.5 .
We evaluate two inference policies over the same masked-future predictor.
DiffuPlex- Listen consumes future positions only during sustained listening, with a minimum retained length of m = 6 m=6 , whereas DiffuPlex- Speak removes this state restriction and uses m = 2 m=2 .
The prediction at h = 1 h=1 is always retained, ensuring that each backbone wake advances the interaction by at least one 80ms frame.
We use the original backbone sampling configuration and fix the generation seed to 0.
Further data processing, training, and inference details are provided in Appendices D.1 – D.3 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate DiffuPlex along four axes: full-duplex interaction, general spoken-language capability, human evaluation, and inference efficiency.
For full-duplex interaction, we use Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) to evaluate pause handling, backchanneling, turn-taking, and user interruption, and additionally evaluate on Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) under overlapping and interfering speech.
We evaluate general spoken-language capability with VoiceBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and OpenAudioBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) , reporting both the assistant text stream ( s → t s{\rightarrow}t ) and transcripts of generated speech ( s → s s{\rightarrow}s ).
For human evaluation, we measure speech quality (NMOS) on the assistant response following an interruption and conversational quality (DMOS) over the full interaction, using user-interruption examples from Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0.
Finally, we measure inference efficiency on a fixed 60-clip subset of Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0, with 15 clips per task on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.
We report wall-clock streaming, end-to-end GPU, and Core LM time, together with frames advanced per backbone wake and wake-frame latency.
Detailed evaluation, runtime, and human-evaluation protocols are provided in Appendices E and F .

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en:
We compare against Moshi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) , PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) , and personaplex-rl-seamless , the autoregressive backbone used by DiffuPlex.
To test whether similar computational savings can be obtained simply by skipping some autoregressive backbone calls, we additionally construct three training-free deferred-execution baselines using the same frozen backbone: PAD , Silero , and Smart Turn .
On a deferred 80ms interaction step, these baselines do not run the backbone or predict the skipped frame; instead, they emit silence for the assistant and resume autoregressive generation at a later step. PAD skips backbone calls while the assistant predicts silence, Silero while the user is speaking, and Smart Turn until a turn-ending detector predicts that the user has finished.
We cap the interval between autoregressive backbone calls at R ∈ { 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 } R\in\{2,4,6,8\} interaction steps.
Further implementation details are in Appendix D.4 .

We next examine why DiffuPlex wakes the backbone again after producing a draft.
A wake occurs either when the retained draft is exhausted or when new user speech triggers revision.
When the draft is exhausted, DiffuPlex advances only 1.17 frames on average for Listen and 1.48 for Speak ; 98.2% and 81.5% of these wakes, respectively, occur after a single frame.
Revision-triggered wakes instead occur after several draft frames have already been consumed, with mean advancements of 4.24 and 3.79 frames and medians of 4 and 3.
In other words, a short wake interval usually means that only a short prefix was retained in the first place, rather than that a longer retained draft was quickly revised.
When revision does occur, several retained frames have typically been consumed.
Additional wake-level diagnostics and revision analyses are provided in
Appendix I.1 .

Why does future speech degrade? We next investigate the speech-quality degradation of DiffuPlex- Speak . personaplex-rl-seamless models assistant audio using a semantic codebook, cb0, followed by seven acoustic codebooks, cb1–7.
Because cb1–7 are natively delayed by one temporal step, the cb0 corresponding to a given physical audio frame appears one temporal position earlier in the model sequence and is therefore already available when the autoregressive model predicts cb1–7 for that frame.
DiffuPlex preserves this native delay pattern, but at future depths h ≥ 2 h\geq 2 all assistant streams are masked, so future cb1–7 must be predicted without the same-frame cb0 that would normally condition them.
To test whether this missing conditioning contributes to the degradation, we use the 199 valid user-interruption examples from Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 and replace only the masked cb0 with the ground-truth cb0 for the physical frame whose cb1–7 are being predicted.
During assistant speech, this reduces the cb1–7 negative log-likelihood from 5.702 to 5.611
( Δ = 0.091 \Delta=0.091 , 95% CI [0.081, 0.101]), compared with a much smaller reduction during silence ( Δ = 0.029 \Delta=0.029 ).
These results show that same-frame semantic conditioning has a substantially larger effect on acoustic-token prediction during speech than during silence.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced DiffuPlex, a masked-future prediction framework for reducing sequential forward passes in autoregressive full-duplex speech models.
Rather than invoking the backbone at every interaction frame, DiffuPlex predicts multiple future positions in a single wake, consumes a confident prefix, and revises only the unplayed future when observed user speech deviates from the prediction.
Experiments show that this rolling generation reduces backbone wakes and measured Core LM time
while largely preserving full-duplex interaction behavior and general spoken-language capability.
Our analyses show that confidence-based retention and revision play complementary roles in controlling future consumption, and identify missing autoregressive audio-token conditioning as a source of degradation in deeper future speech.
These results suggest that predicting interaction ahead can provide a path toward more compute-efficient real-time full-duplex generation.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
DiffuPlex has several limitations that suggest directions for future work.
First, DiffuPlex is adapted from a pretrained autoregressive backbone rather than trained natively for masked-future generation.
We freeze the original backbone and train future-gated LoRA adapters together with learned MASK embeddings using self-distillation from the autoregressive model.
This design makes it possible to add masked-future prediction without retraining the full model, but it also means that the backbone was not originally optimized to represent several uncertain future interaction frames at once.
A model trained specifically for masked-future generation may therefore make better use of the additional future context.
blocks.zh:
DiffuPlex有一些局限性,为今后的工作指明方向。
首先,DiffuPlex是从一个经过预先训练的自旋骨干来改编而来,而不是为被遮住的未来一代而本土训练.
我们冻结原有的主干线,并训练未来型的LORA适配器,以及使用自递式模型的自递式自倒式的有学识的MASK嵌入.
这种设计使得无需再培训完整的模型就可以添加被遮掩的未来预测,但也意味着骨干最初并没有被优化,以同时代表几个不确定的未来互动框架.
因此,专门为蒙面未来一代培训的模式可以更好地利用未来的额外情况。

blocks.en:
Second, DiffuPlex separates future prediction from the decisions about how much of that prediction to use.
The predictor is trained to model future user and assistant frames, whereas retention and revision are controlled by inference-time rules based on prediction confidence and a fixed revision threshold.
These rules work well in our experiments, but they are not learned jointly with the future predictor.
Jointly learning future prediction, retention, and revision could allow the model to better trade off computation, interaction responsiveness, and prediction reliability.
blocks.zh:
第二,DiffuPlex将未来预测与关于该预测有多少使用的决定分开.
预测器经过了培训,可以对未来的用户和助理框架进行建模,而保留和修订则由基于预测可信度和固定修订阈值的推断时间规则所控制.
这些规则在我们实验中运作良好,但是它们与未来的预测者并没有共同学习.
联合学习未来的预测、保留和修订可以使模型更好地取舍计算、互动反应和预测可靠性。

blocks.en:
Third, aggressive future consumption remains more difficult during assistant speech than during listening.
DiffuPlex- Speak reduces backbone wake frequency more aggressively, but this comes with lower speech naturalness.
As analyzed in Section 5.5 and Appendix I.2 , one contributor is the loss of same-frame semantic conditioning for deeper future acoustic codebooks: when predicting farther into the future, the acoustic codebooks can no longer condition on the assistant semantic codebook that would normally already be available under autoregressive generation.
Our interventions show that restoring same-frame cb0 improves acoustic-token prediction, while autoregressive replay recovers much of the measured quality gap; neither provides a practical solution to future speech generation.
Improved future audio modeling is therefore still needed before long assistant-speech segments can be consumed as reliably as silent listening segments.
blocks.zh:
第三,在助理演讲期间,今后积极的消费仍然比听话时更加困难。
DiffuPlex-Speak更有力地减少了骨干唤醒频率,但这与语音自然性较低有关。
正如第5.5节和附录一.2所分析的那样,一个贡献者是失去了更深层未来声学编码本的同帧语义调:当预测未来更远时,声学编码本就不能再对通常在自递生成下已经提供的助语义语义调代码作条件.
我们的干预措施表明,恢复同帧cb0可以改善声学-声学预测,而自旋回放则可以恢复所测量的许多质量差距;两者都不能为未来的语音生成提供实用的解决办法.
因此,今后还需要改进音频建模,才能像静默的监听部分那样可靠地使用长长的助听片段。

blocks.en:
Finally, our main experiments use personaplex-rl-seamless as the backbone.
We additionally apply the same training and inference framework to PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) in Appendix H.1 .
Although this variant still reduces the number of backbone wakes, its full-duplex interaction behavior degrades substantially, particularly on pause handling and interruption behavior.
This result suggests that transferring DiffuPlex across backbone checkpoints is not automatic and may depend on the interaction behavior already learned by the underlying model.
We have not yet evaluated the method on substantially different full-duplex architectures.
Moreover, the measured wall-clock and Core LM speedups depend on the evaluated hardware, software stack, and implementation.
Evaluating DiffuPlex across additional architectures and deployment environments remains important future work.

我们还对附录H.1中的PersonaPlex(Roy等,2026年)适用同样的培训和推论框架。

blocks.en: C.1 Backbone Architecture
blocks.zh: C.1 后骨结构

blocks.en:
We build DiffuPlex on personaplex-rl-seamless ( Ohashi et al., 2026 ) , a post-trained PersonaPlex checkpoint that follows the Moshi-style full-duplex architecture ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) .
The model operates at 12.5Hz, corresponding to one interaction frame every 80ms, and represents the two sides of the conversation using parallel user and assistant streams.
Its temporal backbone models the interaction across successive positions, while a depth transformer autoregressively predicts the audio codebooks associated with each position.
blocks.zh:
我们建造了一个经过训练的PersonaPlex检查站(Défossez等,2024年)。
该模型在12.5Hz运行,每80ms对应一个交互框架,并使用平行的用户和助手流代表对话的两面.
它的时间主干模型是跨相继位置的相互作用,而一个深度变压器则自动地预测了与每个位置相关的音频代码簿.

blocks.en:
The model contains one assistant text stream together with eight Mimi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) audio codebooks for the assistant and eight for the user.
Following the terminology and training objective of the backbone, we refer to codebook 0 (cb0) as the semantic codebook and codebooks 1–7 (cb1–7) as the acoustic codebooks.
An important difference from the original Moshi architecture is that PersonaPlex ( Roy et al., 2026 ) predicts audio codebooks for both sides of the interaction: whereas Moshi’s depth transformer predicts eight assistant audio codebooks, PersonaPlex predicts eight assistant and eight user codebooks, for 16 audio streams in total.
This joint user-assistant prediction structure is retained by the post-trained personaplex-rl-seamless backbone and, consequently, by DiffuPlex.
The predicted user audio is not played back; during streaming inference, the actual user codebooks are supplied by the incoming audio stream, while the generated assistant codebooks are used for playback.
In our measurements using the official implementations, PersonaPlex and personaplex-rl-seamless require more Core LM time and wall-clock time than Moshi on the same runtime subset, as shown in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
该模型包含1个助理文本流并配有8个Mimi(Défossez等,2024年)供助理使用的音频代码簿和8个供用户使用的代码.
按照主干术语和培训目标,我们把代码簿0 (cb0)称为语义代码簿,把代码簿1–7 (cb1–7)称为相声代码簿.
与原Moshi架构的一个重要区别是PersonaPlex(Roy等,2026年)预测了互动的两边的音频代码:而Moshi的深度变压器预测了8个助理音频代码,PersonaPlex预测了8个助手和8个用户代码,总共16个音频流.
这种用户-辅助联合预测结构由经过培训后的个人-rl-无缝骨干保留,因此由DiffuPlex保留。
预想的用户音频不回放;在流出推断中,实际的用户代码簿由入来音频流提供,而生成的助理代码簿则用于回放.
如表2所示,在我们使用正式执行量的测量中,PersonaPlex和permanaplex-rl-seal-seamle需要比同一运行时间子集上的Moshi更多的核心LM时间和时钟时间。

blocks.en:
The backbone uses a native one-position delay between cb0 and cb1–7.
As a result, when the temporal backbone computes the representation used to predict cb1–7 for a physical frame, cb0 from that same frame is already available as an input.
This allows same-frame semantic information to influence the temporal representation itself before the depth transformer predicts the acoustic codebooks.
Without this delay, cb0 and cb1–7 of the same frame would be generated from the same temporal state, leaving their within-frame dependency to be modeled only by the depth transformer.
We describe this alignment precisely in Appendix C.2 ; Moshi reports a theoretical algorithmic latency of 160ms for this streaming architecture ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) .
Despite jointly modeling both sides of the interaction, temporal generation remains autoregressive: under ordinary inference, the temporal backbone is evaluated once every 80ms as the interaction advances.
DiffuPlex targets this sequential temporal-backbone schedule while leaving the underlying stream organization, native delays, and the backbone’s original next-frame prediction shift unchanged.
blocks.zh:
骨干使用cb0至cb1-7之间的原生一站延迟.
因此,当时间主干计算用于预测一个物理框架的cb1–7的表示时,同一框架的cb0已经作为输入提供.
这使得同帧语义信息在深度变压器预测出相声密码本之前,可以影响时间表现本身.
没有这种延迟,同一框架的cb0和cb1-7将从同一个时态产生出,使其内置的依赖性只能由深度变压器来模型.
我们在附录C.2中准确地描述了这种相通性;Moshi报告说,这一流体结构的理论算法延迟为160ms(Défossez等,2024年)。
尽管共同模拟了相互作用的两面,但时间生成仍然是自相递进的:在一般推论下,随着相互作用的推进,时间主干线每80m就会被评价一次.
DiffuPlex针对的是这个相继的时空后骨表,同时离开下流组织,本土延迟,以及骨干最初的下帧预测变化不变.

blocks.en:
This alignment is particularly important for the assistant acoustic codebooks.
To predict cb1–7 of physical frame f f , ordinary autoregressive generation uses model position f + 1 f+1 .
At this position, assistant cb0 of the same physical frame f f is already part of the temporal-backbone input.
Same-frame semantic information can therefore influence the temporal representation before that representation is passed to the depth transformer.
The depth transformer remains autoregressive over the codebooks and can also model dependencies among codebooks within its decoding sequence, but the native delay additionally exposes same-frame cb0 to the temporal backbone itself.
Without this delay, cb0 and cb1–7 of the same physical frame would be generated from the same temporal state, leaving their same-frame dependency to the depth transformer rather than incorporating cb0 into the temporal representation.
blocks.zh:
这种对接对助理声学密码书特别重要.
为了预测cb1–7的物理帧f f,普通自旋生成使用模型位置f+1 f+1.
在这个位置上,同一个物理框架f f的助手cb0已经是时间后骨输入的一部分.
因此,同帧语义信息可以影响时间表示,然后再将表示传递给深度变压器.
深度变压器在代码本上仍然具有自转性,也可以在其解码序列内对代码本中的依赖性进行模型化处理,但原生延迟又将同帧cb0进一步暴露在了时间主干上.
没有这种延迟,同一物理框架的cb0和cb1-7将从同一时间状态产生,使其同帧依赖深度变压器,而不是将cb0纳入时间表示.

blocks.en:
DiffuPlex preserves this native delay pattern.
It masks only inputs that would not yet have been generated or observed at the backbone wake that predicts a future position.
This distinction becomes important in our analysis of future speech generation in Appendix I.2 .
blocks.zh:
DiffuPlex保留了这种本土延迟模式.
它只掩盖了在预测未来位置的骨干后方尚未产生或观察到的投入。
这一区别在我们分析附录一.2中的未来语音生成时变得很重要。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the exact training layout used for masked future prediction.
For each training example, we concatenate a clean copy of the original sequence with a masked copy of the same sequence, producing a sequence of length 2 ​ T 2T .
The clean copy preserves the realized interaction.
In the masked copy, only the dialog region is modified; the system-prompt region remains unchanged.
blocks.zh:

对于每个训练例子,我们用同一种序列的口罩拷贝将原始序列的清洁拷贝,产生长度为2 T 2T的序列.
干净的复制保留了实现的交互.
在被遮盖的副本中,只有对话框区域被修改;系统即时区域保持不变.

blocks.en:
The masked dialog region is divided into consecutive blocks.
For each block, its length is sampled independently as L blk ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ { 1 , … , W } , L_{\mathrm{blk}}\sim\mathcal{U}\{1,\ldots,W\}, (7) where W = 16 W=16 for the main model.
The final block is truncated if it reaches the end of the dialog region.
Within every block, the lookahead index resets to h = 1 , … , L blk h=1,\ldots,L_{\mathrm{blk}} .
This construction exposes the model to different future distances from a backbone wake while conditioning on a varying amount of realized interaction available at each block boundary.
blocks.zh:
被遮住的对话区域被分为相接的块.
对于每个区块,其长度分别作为L blk ∼ U ⁡ { 1, ..., W }, L_{\ mathrm{ blk}}\sim\ mathcal{ U}\{ 1,\ldots, W\}, (7)其中W=16W为主型号.
如果最后的块到达了对话区域的尽头,则被截断 。
在每一个区块中,望头指数重排为h=1,.,L blk h=1,\ldots,L_{\-mathrm{blk}}.
这一构筑使模型暴露在远离主干钟的未来的不同距离上,同时以每个区块边界上可得到的不同数量的已实现的相互作用为条件。

blocks.en:
For each lookahead, we replace only inputs that would not yet be causally available when that future position is predicted.
The masking schedule is h = 1 \displaystyle h=1 : no streams are masked , \displaystyle:\quad\text{no streams are masked}, (8) h ≥ 2 \displaystyle h\geq 2 : assistant text and assistant cb0–7 are masked , \displaystyle:\quad\text{assistant text and assistant cb0--7 are masked}, h ≥ 3 \displaystyle h\geq 3 : user cb0 is additionally masked , \displaystyle:\quad\text{user cb0 is additionally masked}, h ≥ 4 \displaystyle h\geq 4 : user cb1–7 are additionally masked . \displaystyle:\quad\text{user cb1--7 are additionally masked}. Each stream uses its own learned MASK embedding.
The asymmetry between assistant and user streams reflects their different availability at inference.
Future assistant outputs have not yet been generated and are therefore masked from h = 2 h=2 .
By contrast, user audio observed during the current 80ms interaction frame becomes available as input only at subsequent model positions.
Under the native delay pattern, user cb0 remains available at h = 2 h=2 and is masked from h = 3 h=3 , while user cb1–7 remain available through h = 3 h=3 and are masked from h = 4 h=4 , at which point all user streams are masked.
The native delays in Eq. 5 are left unchanged.

blocks.en:
The staircase in Figure 4 therefore describes input availability , not an attention mask.
Temporal attention remains causal.
For a position in the masked copy, attention includes the realized context preceding its block from the clean copy and masked positions up to the current position within the same block.
It does not attend to later positions in the current block or to positions from preceding blocks in the masked copy.
Instead, interaction preceding the current block boundary is provided by the corresponding clean context.
Each block therefore represents a fresh future prediction from the realized interaction at its boundary, rather than a continuation of the preceding masked block.
At h = 1 h=1 , no input is replaced by MASK, so the input is identical to the original next-frame autoregressive path.
blocks.zh:
因此,图4中的楼梯描述了投入的可用性,而不是一个注意口罩。
暂时的注意仍然是因果性的。
对于被遮住的复制件中的位置,注意包括从被遮住的复制件和被遮住的复制件到同一块内现有位置之前的已实现上下文.
它不处理当前区块的后期位置,也不处理被遮盖副本中前期区块的位置。
相反,当前块边界之前的相互作用由相应的干净上下文提供.
因此,每个区块代表着对其边界上已实现的相互作用的一种新的未来预测,而不是前一个被掩盖的区块的延续.
在 h = 1 h = 1 时,没有输入被 MASK 所取代,因此输入与原下帧自递回路径完全相同.

blocks.en: Appendix D Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 执行情况 细节

blocks.en: D.1 Data Processing
blocks.zh: D.1 数据处理

blocks.en:
We train DiffuPlex on Seamless Interaction ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) , a large corpus of face-to-face dyadic conversations recorded on separate speaker channels.
The source dataset contains more than 4,000h of interaction from more than 4,000 participants and includes both naturalistic conversations and improvised scenarios.
We process the two speaker channels jointly so that their original conversational timing, including pauses, overlaps, and interruptions, is preserved.
We first resample all audio to 24kHz.
Each channel is transcribed with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , using English as the fixed language, and the resulting transcript is aligned to the waveform at the word level using Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B ( Shi et al., 2026 ) .
We use Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) to identify speech activity and encode each channel with the same Mimi codec used by the backbone, producing eight codebooks at 12.5Hz.
The resulting aligned representation therefore retains the original 80ms interaction grid used by personaplex-rl-seamless .
blocks.zh:
我们训练DiffuPlex关于无缝互动(Agrawal等,2025年),这是在单独的演讲频道上记录的大量面对面对话。
源数据集包含来自4000多名参与者的4000多小时互动,包括了自然对话与即兴情景.
我们共同处理两个发言人频道,以便保留其最初的对话时间,包括暂停、重叠和中断。
我们首先将所有音频重拍到 24k 赫兹
每个信道都以Qune3-ASR-1.7B(Shi等,2026年)为转写,以英语为固定语言,所生成的语录与以Qune3-ForcedAligner-0.6B(Shi等,2026年)为单词水平的波形一致.
我们使用Silero VAD(Silero Team,2024年)来识别语音活性,并用主干部使用的同名Mimi编码来编码每个频道,在12:5制作出8个代码本. 赫兹
因此,由此产生的对齐表示保留了Personaplex-rl-seamles使用的80ms原始交互网格。

blocks.en:
We apply session-level filtering before constructing training examples.
We first remove sessions containing residual non-Latin transcription.
We then filter sessions for microphone leakage using a transcript-similarity threshold of 0.30 and an overlap threshold of 0.20.
We additionally remove one-sided conversations in which either speaker has no transcribed words, sessions with low speech density where speech occupies less than 60% of the active region, sessions with an active region shorter than 30s, sessions containing an intermediate silence longer than 10s, and sessions with strong speaker imbalance where either speaker accounts for at least 75% of the total speaking duration.
After filtering, 42,613 sessions remain and 21,717 are excluded.
blocks.zh:
在构建培训实例之前,我们先进行课级过滤。
我们首先删除包含剩余非拉丁语抄本的会话.
然后利用0.30和0.20的重叠阈值,过滤麦克风泄漏的会话。
此外,我们删除了片面的谈话,其中任一发言者没有转写文字,发言密度低但占活跃地区60%以下的会议,活动地区短于30人的会议,中间沉默时间超过10人的会议,以及发言者严重失衡的会议,其中任一发言者至少占总发言时间的75%。
过滤后,保留42,613个会话,不包括21,717个会话.

blocks.en:
From the retained sessions, we reserve 200 session-disjoint conversations, approximately 14h, for validation.
The remaining training split contains 42,413 sessions totaling 2,728.5h of conversation from 3,516 participants.
It contains 28,242 naturalistic sessions totaling 1,628.7h and 14,171 improvised sessions totaling 1,099.8h.
We use both speaker assignments as training examples when valid voice references are available, resulting in 84,183 role-conditioned training examples.
blocks.zh:
从保留的会议来看,我们保留了大约14小时的200个会话分会话进行验证。
其余的培训分期培训包括42 413个培训班,共2 728.5小时,来自3 516人。
它包含28 242个自然课,共计1 628.7小时,14 171个简易课,共计1 099.8小时。
在提供有效语音参考资料时,我们使用这两个演讲者的任务作为培训实例,结果产生了84 183个以角色为条件的培训实例。

blocks.en:
We additionally construct a voice-reference pool for each speaker.
Candidate references are between 2s and 10s long, contain at least three ASR words, and are normalized to − 24 -24 LUFS.
We retain up to six references per channel and mark a reference as clean when it does not overlap speech from the other channel.
During training, we preferentially select a clean reference that lies outside the sampled interaction window, so that voice conditioning does not expose speech from the target region.
blocks.zh:
我们还为每位发言者建造了一个语音参考资料库。
候选参考书长在2到10个之间,包含至少3个ASR单词,并被正常化为−24-24 LUFS.
每个频道最多保留了6个参考文献,如果一个参考文献与另一个频道的语音不相重叠,则标出干净。
在训练期间,我们优先选择一个位于被采样的交互窗口外的干净的参考,这样语音调理就不会暴露来自目标区域的语音.

blocks.en: D.2 Training
blocks.zh: D.2 培训

blocks.en:
We optimize the distillation objective in Eq. 1 over positions belonging to the dialog region.
System-prompt positions, padding, and positions without defined targets under the backbone’s native stream delays are excluded from the loss.
Following the backbone objective, we use w q = 1 w_{q}=1 for the semantic codebook of each speaker and w q = 0.02 w_{q}=0.02 for cb1–7.
The distribution p ¯ text \bar{p}_{\mathrm{text}} groups the full assistant-text distribution p text p_{\mathrm{text}} into the three interaction states PAD, EPAD, and lexical.
Because most text positions are non-lexical, matching p text p_{\mathrm{text}} alone can underemphasize the coarse interaction-state distinctions that govern full-duplex behavior, including when the assistant remains silent, begins speaking, backchannels, or yields to user speech.
We therefore additionally distill p ¯ text \bar{p}_{\mathrm{text}} to preserve these conversational dynamics, assigning its KL term equal weight to the KL on p text p_{\mathrm{text}} .
The losses are pooled over all valid positions rather than normalized separately by future lookahead.
blocks.zh:
我们优化了Eq. 1中的蒸馏目标 而不是属于对话区域的位置
系统即时位置、垫地位置和没有确定目标的位置在主干线的本土流延迟中不包括在损失中。
按照主干目标,我们使用w q = 1 w q = = q = o 1 用于每个发言者的语义编码本,而w q = 0.02 w q = q = 0.02用于 cb1–7.
分布 p' text \bar{p}_{\- mathrm{ text}}} 将完整助理文本分布 p_{\- mathrm{ text}}} 组合到三个交互状态 PAD, EPAD, 和 lexical 。
因为大多数文本位置是非语法的,仅匹配p文本 p_{\-mathrm{text}}能低估制约全复行为的粗糙交互-状态区分,包括当助手保持沉默,开始说话,回声道,或向用户语音输出时.
因此,我们额外提炼出p' text \bar{p}_{\ mathrm{text}来保留这些对话动态,将其KL术语在p_{\ mathrm{text}}上赋予KL同等分量.
损失集中在所有有效位置上,而不是按未来前景另行正常化。

blocks.en:
We train the stream-specific MASK embeddings and future-gated LoRA adapters described in Section 3.1 .
LoRA is applied to both the temporal backbone and the depth transformer with rank 128 and scaling factor 2.0, and the MASK vectors are initialized with norm-matched random directions.
Each sampled training window contains at most 2,047 code frames; after inserting the backbone’s initial token and applying the native stream-delay construction, this yields 2,048 temporal model positions, corresponding to approximately 163.8s at 12.5Hz.
The clean and masked copies are concatenated as described in Appendix C.3 , and we do not prepend additional dialog context outside the sampled window.
We construct the training prompt in the same form used by PersonaPlex: a speaker voice reference is followed by six silence frames, the persona text prompt, and another six silence frames, while the user side is filled with the backbone’s sine-wave conditioning during this priming region.
When several valid voice references are available, we preferentially use one outside the sampled dialog window.
blocks.zh:
我们训练第3.1节所描述的溪流特定的MASK嵌入和未来的LORA适配器。
LORA既被应用于时干和深度变压器上,分级为128级和缩放因子为2.0,而MASK向量被初始化为规范相匹配的随机方向.
每个抽样培训窗口最多包含2,047个代码框;在插入主干线的初始信号并应用本土流-延迟构造后,该数据得出了2,048个时间模型位置,相当于12.5Hz的约163.8个.
如附录C.3所描述的那样,清洁和被遮盖的拷贝是相容的,我们不预先将附加的对话框上下文放在被采样的窗口外。
我们用 PersonaPlex 所用的同样形式构建培训提示:一个扬声器的语音参考,后面是6个静音框,即Persona 文本提示,另外还有6个静音框,而用户方则在此发光地段充满了骨干正弦波调.
当有几种有效的语音引用时,我们优先在被抽样的对话框窗口外使用一个.

blocks.en:
We optimize for 526 steps using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.1 0.1 , and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
We use a OneCycle learning-rate schedule with a 15% warmup followed by cosine decay, bfloat16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and random seed 0.
The per-GPU batch size is 4 with two gradient-accumulation steps on four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs, giving an effective batch size of 32.
Training processes 16,832 sampled windows drawn from 8,480 distinct sessions, corresponding to approximately 702h of conversational audio.
We save checkpoints every 263 steps and use the final checkpoint at step 526 for all main experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 AdamW(Lohchilov and Hutter, 2019)优化了526个步骤, 学习率为 10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4} 体重衰减 0. 1, 梯度剪接为 1.0 - 1.
我们使用一个单管学习率表,其中热能为15%,然后是余弦衰变、bfloat16精度、梯度检查和随机种子0。
每GPU批量尺寸为4个,在4个NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上有两个梯度相加步骤,给出了有效的批量尺寸为32个.
培训过程从8 480个不同课程中抽取出16 832个抽样窗口,相当于约702小时的对话音频。
我们每节省263个步骤的检查站,并在第526步使用最后检查站进行所有主要试验。

blocks.en: D.3 Inference
blocks.zh: D.3 推论

blocks.en:
For all main experiments, we use a future horizon of W = 16 W=16 , a confidence threshold of τ conf = 0.80 \tau_{\mathrm{conf}}=0.80 , and a revision threshold of τ rev = − 0.5 \tau_{\mathrm{rev}}=-0.5 .
As described in Section 3.2 , the ordinary next-frame prediction at h = 1 h=1 is always retained.
DiffuPlex- Listen retains positions beyond h = 1 h=1 only while the sampled assistant text state remains PAD and requires a minimum candidate prefix of m = 6 m=6 , whereas DiffuPlex- Speak permits PAD, EPAD, and lexical states with m = 2 m=2 .
If the candidate prefix does not reach the policy-specific minimum, we retain only h = 1 h=1 .
Thus, Listen advances conservatively through predicted PAD states, while Speak can additionally consume confidently predicted EPAD and lexical states.
blocks.zh:
对于所有主要实验,我们使用W=16W=16的未来地平线,信任阈值为\\ conf = 0.80\tau_{\mathrm{conf}}=0.80,修正阈值为\ rev = - 0.5\tau_{\mathrm{rev}}=-0.5.
如第3.2节所描述,通常保留h=1h=1的普通下帧预测.
DiffuPlex-Listen只保留h = 1 h=1之外的位置,而被抽样的助理文本状态仍为PAD,并且需要最小的候选前缀为m = 6 m=6,而diffuPlex-Speak许可为PAD,EPAD,和有m = 2 m=2的词典状态.
如果候选人前缀没有达到政策特定的最低要求,我们只保留h=1h=1.
因此,Liste通过预测的PAD状态保守地推进,而Speak则可以额外地消耗预测的EPAD和词汇状态.

blocks.en:
Apart from the retention and revision rules, we preserve the original backbone sampling procedure.
Assistant audio codebooks are sampled with temperature 0.8 0.8 and top- k = 250 k=250 , while assistant text uses temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- k = 25 k=25 .
Following Section 3.2 , retention confidence is computed from the probability of the sampled assistant text token under the logits before temperature scaling and top- k k filtering.
We use random seed 0 for all main evaluations.
We also retain the official PersonaPlex priming procedure: the SC0001.wav voice prompt is encoded first, followed by six silence frames, the system text prompt, and another six silence frames.
Task-specific system prompts are provided with their corresponding evaluation protocols in Appendix E .
After priming, incoming user audio is encoded by Mimi at 12.5Hz following the autoregressive backbone.
blocks.zh:
除了保留和修订规则外,我们还保留了原始的主干取样程序。
助理音频编码簿的取样温度为0.8 0.8,上-克=250克=250;而助理文本则使用0.7 0.7和上-克=25克=25.
下节 3.2,保留置信度从在温度缩放和上-克滤取之前在对数下被采样的助手文本符的概率来计算出.
我们使用随机的种子0进行所有主要评价.
我们还保留了PersonaPlex正弦程序:SC0001.wav语音快音被先编码,然后是6个静音框,系统文本快音,另外还有6个静音框.
附录E为针对特定任务的系统提示提供了相应的评价协议。
点击后,进入的用户音频由咪咪以12:5编码. Hz跟随自递骨干.

blocks.en:
At each backbone wake, DiffuPlex predicts a future block and selects a contiguous prefix for retention.
The assistant audio codebooks of the retained frames are decoded in parallel across temporal positions, while remaining autoregressive over codebooks within each frame, then placed in a playback queue and emitted at their original 80ms interaction times.
The corresponding future user distributions are stored only for consistency checking; actual incoming user frames, rather than these predictions, form the realized interaction used at the next backbone wake.
The temporal backbone wakes again when the retained prefix is exhausted or when newly observed user input triggers revision of the unplayed future.

在每个骨干钟时,DiffuPlex都会预测出未来的块并选择一个相接的前缀来保留.
保留框的辅助音频编码簿在时间位置上平行地解码,而在每个框内对代码簿保持自回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回
对应的未来用户分布仅被存储用于一致性检查;实际收到的用户帧,而不是这些预测,形成下个主干钟所使用已实现的交互.
当所保留的前缀已用完或当新观察到的用户输入触发了对未播放的未来的修订时,时间主干线再次被唤醒.

blocks.en: D.4 Deferred-Execution Baselines
blocks.zh: D.4 推迟执行基线

blocks.en:
The deferred-execution baselines test whether backbone calls can be reduced without predicting future interaction.
Rather than generating a future block as DiffuPlex does, these methods retain the original autoregressive backbone and decide only whether its next update can be postponed.
All three baselines use the same frozen personaplex-rl-seamless backbone, with no MASK embeddings or LoRA adapters, and share the same deferred-execution mechanism described below.
They differ only in the controller signal used to determine when deferral is permitted.
Deferral is permitted only while the assistant is silent: we require both the previously emitted assistant text token to be PAD and the corresponding decoded assistant-audio frame to have RMS below a silence threshold τ sil \tau_{\mathrm{sil}} .
The audio condition is necessary because PAD tokens can also occur within spoken regions; using the text stream alone can therefore incorrectly classify an ongoing utterance as silence.
We set τ sil = 2.74670 × 10 − 4 \tau_{\mathrm{sil}}=2.74670\times 10^{-4} from the official PersonaPlex silence codebooks by streaming-decoding 2,000 silence frames, discarding the first 25 frames to remove decoder warm-up effects, taking the 99th percentile of the remaining RMS values ( 2.19736 × 10 − 4 2.19736\times 10^{-4} ), and adding a 25% margin.
No evaluation audio is used to determine this threshold.

blocks.en:
While execution is deferred, the assistant text stream is fixed to PAD and the official silence audio codebooks are used for the assistant streams, respecting the backbone’s native stream delays.
Incoming user audio continues to be encoded by Mimi and is stored normally.
When the controller wakes the backbone, the accumulated known user inputs and imposed assistant-silence trajectory are processed causally in a single temporal-backbone call, whose final position produces the next autoregressive prediction and avoids an additional redundant backbone call.
We cap each deferred segment by a maximum run length R ∈ { 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 } R\in\{2,4,6,8\} interaction frames.
The count includes the current backbone wake; for example, R = 6 R=6 consists of the current wake followed by at most five deferred frames.

PAD . The PAD controller uses only the backbone’s own assistant-text prediction.
At an eligible silent backbone wake, if the sampled assistant text token is PAD with probability at least 0.80 0.80 , the controller starts a deferred segment, using the same sampled-token probability definition as the DiffuPlex confidence criterion.
Because no new backbone prediction is produced during the deferred frames, the segment continues until the maximum run length R R is reached.
Thus, for R = 6 R=6 , the qualifying wake is followed by five deferred frames, after which the backbone is forced to wake again and produce a new autoregressive prediction.
If the PAD condition is not satisfied at a wake, no new deferral is started.
This baseline therefore tests whether confident current-frame silence alone is sufficient to postpone future autoregressive updates without an external speech or turn detector.

Silero . The Silero controller uses Silero VAD v6.2.1 ( Silero Team, 2024 ) in streaming mode on the incoming user audio.
Audio is resampled to 16kHz mono and processed causally in 512-sample (32ms) chunks using the official VADIterator .
We use a speech threshold of 0.5 0.5 , the released hysteresis exit threshold of 0.35 0.35 , min_silence_duration_ms = 200 =200 , and speech_pad_ms = 0 =0 .
When the user is speaking, the backbone remains deferred while Silero continues to process the incoming audio.
The backbone wakes at whichever occurs first: Silero reports that the user has been silent for at least 200ms, or the deferred segment reaches the maximum run length R R .
Thus, if speech continues throughout an R = 6 R=6 segment, the qualifying wake is followed by five deferred frames before the backbone is forced to wake again.
All Silero decisions are causal: we act only when the streaming VAD reports a transition, without shifting the decision back to an earlier estimated speech boundary.

Smart Turn . The Smart Turn controller augments the same Silero frontend with Smart Turn v3.2 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 , using the released INT8 CPU model smart-turn-v3.2-cpu.onnx .
At each Silero -detected speech end, Smart Turn is evaluated on the most recent user-audio context, truncated to the latest 8s and zero-padded at the beginning when shorter.
If the completion probability is at least 0.5 0.5 , the backbone wakes; otherwise, it remains deferred.
Deferral then continues until a later speech end produces a completion probability of at least 0.5 0.5 , the maximum run length R R is reached, or 3s of continuous silence forces a wake.
For the primary Smart Turn baseline, we account for the controller’s measured inference latency: a completion decision is applied at the first 80ms interaction frame after its result becomes available.
If the user resumes speaking before that result is available, the decision is discarded as stale.

blocks.en:
Silero and Smart Turn decisions are precomputed before timed generation and replayed at their corresponding interaction times, so that controller execution does not affect GPU timing.
We therefore exclude controller inference from the reported streaming-model runtime and report its CPU cost separately.
For the primary Smart Turn configuration, the measured controller cost is 13.90 CPU-ms per interaction second, approximately 80% of which comes from the continuously running Silero frontend.
blocks.zh:
Silero和Smart Turn决定是在定时生成前预先计算,并在相应的交互时间重放,这样控制器执行不会影响GPU的时间.
因此,我们把控制器推论排除在所报告的流式运行时间之外,并分别报告其CPU成本。
对于主智能转动配置,所测量的控制器成本为13.90 CPU-ms每互动秒,其中约80%来自持续运行的Silero前端.

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录E 评价详情

blocks.en:

Unless otherwise stated, all systems use the inference configuration in Appendix D.3 .
Model names and system prompts follow the corresponding backbone or benchmark conventions described below.
blocks.zh:
我们为主要文件中所报告的互动、一般能力和运行时间结果提供完整的评价协议。
除非另有说明,所有系统都使用附录D.3中的推论配置.

blocks.en: E.1 Full-Duplex Benchmarks
blocks.zh: E.1 完全双重基准

blocks.en:
We evaluate full-duplex interaction using Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and v1.5 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
Unlike the single-turn spoken-language benchmarks considered later, these evaluations preserve continuous full-duplex generation throughout the input, since when the assistant chooses to speak, remain silent, backchannel, or yield is itself part of the behavior being measured.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0(Lin等,2025年)和v1.5(Lin等,2026年)来评价全双互动.
与后来考虑的单回合口语基准不同,这些评价在整个投入中保持连续的全双倍生成,因为当助理选择说话,保持沉默,回通道,或收益本身是被测量行为的一部分.

blocks.en:
Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 contains 727 clips spanning four interaction behaviors.
Pause handling consists of 216 Candor ( Reece et al., 2023 ) clips and 137 synthetic clips, smooth turn-taking contains 119 Candor clips, backchanneling contains 55 ICC ( Umair et al., 2024 ) clips, and user interruption contains 200 synthetic clips.
For each example, the user waveform is streamed through Mimi and the assistant generates freely until the input waveform ends; assistant activity is never suppressed during the interaction.
blocks.zh:
Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0包含727个片段,跨越了4个交互行为.
暂停处理由216 Candor(Reece等,2023年)和137个合成片段组成,平滑取回带包含 119 Candor剪辑,后道取出包含55个ICC(Umair等,2024年)剪辑,用户中断则包含200个合成剪辑.
对每一个例子来说,用户的波形通过米米来流出,助手可以自由生成,直到输入波形结束;助理活性在交互过程中从未被压制.

blocks.en:
We follow the system-prompt convention of personaplex-rl-seamless .
Pause handling, smooth turn-taking, and backchanneling use You enjoy having a good conversation. ,
whereas user interruption uses You are a wise and friendly teacher. Answer questions or provide advice in a clear and engaging way. We use the official SC0001.wav voice prompt and the priming procedure described in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们遵循系统即时的无缝人公约。
暂停处理、平稳转弯和回通道使用 你喜欢好好的谈话 , (中文(简体) ).
用户中断使用 你是一个明智和友好的老师。 以明确和参与的方式回答问题或提供建议。 我们使用官方的SC0001.wav语音快取和附录D.3所描述的标点程序。

blocks.en:
We use the official benchmark evaluation scripts and metric definitions.
Turn-Over Rate (TOR) measures whether the assistant takes a conversational turn; the official evaluator counts an output as a turn when an ASR transcription is present and either its duration is at least 1s or it contains more than three words.
Lower TOR is preferred for pause handling and backchanneling, where a full assistant response is generally undesirable, whereas higher TOR is preferred for smooth turn-taking and user interruption.
For smooth turn-taking and interruption, latency measures the onset of the first assistant word relative to the end of the corresponding user input.
Backchannel frequency measures how often the model produces backchannels, and backchannel JSD measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between their timing distribution and the reference ICC distribution.
For user interruption, response appropriateness (Judge) is additionally scored on the official 1–5 scale.
We use nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 ( Xu et al., 2023 ) for ASR-dependent metrics and gpt-5.6-luna 2 2 2 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna with reasoning disabled for the interruption judge, while retaining the official prompt.
blocks.zh:
我们使用官方基准评价脚本和衡量定义。
Turn-Over rate(TOR)衡量助理是否进行对话转弯;当有ASR转录时,官方评价员将一出输出算作转弯,或者持续时间至少为一秒,或者包含三个多字.
在暂停处理和回路处理方面,偏好使用较低的TOR,因为一般不欢迎完全的助手响应,而偏好使用较高的TOR来进行平稳的转接和用户中断.
对于平稳的转接和中断,耐用度比起相应的用户输入的结束来测量第一个助理词的起止.
后道频率测量模型产生后道频率,后道JSD测量它们的时间分布与参考ICC分布之间的差异.
对于用户中断,反应适当性(法官)按正式的1至5级评分。
我们使用nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2(Xu等人,2023年)来进行ASR依赖的度量衡和gpt-5.6-luna 2 2 2 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna,为中断裁判设置了推理障碍,同时保留了官方提示.

blocks.en:
Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 contains 498 examples covering background speech (100), talking to another person (100), user backchannels (98), and user interruptions (200).
Each example provides an input containing the target overlap event together with a corresponding clean input in which that event is absent.
We therefore run each system separately on both input.wav and clean_input.wav and apply the official paired evaluation protocol to the resulting outputs.
Background speech, talking-to-other, and user-backchannel examples use the conversational system prompt above, while user interruption uses the teacher prompt.
blocks.zh:
Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5包含498个实例,涵盖背景演讲(100个),与他人交谈(100个),用户后通道(98个)和用户中断(200个).
每个实例都提供了包含目标重叠事件的投入,以及该事件不存在的相应清洁投入。
因此,我们将每个系统分别运行在输入.wav和clean-input.wav上,并将正式的配对评价协议应用于所产生的产出。
背景语音,对口交谈,以及用户-后通道实例使用上方的对口系统即时,而用户中断则使用老师即时.

blocks.en:
The benchmark measures how assistant behavior changes in response to the overlap event.
Its official evaluation includes response-behavior distributions, stop and response latency, and changes in speech characteristics before and after the event, including UTMOSv2 ( Baba et al., 2024 ) , speaking rate, pitch statistics, and intensity statistics.
For the LLM-based behavior classification, we use gpt-5.6-luna with reasoning disabled while retaining the official evaluation prompt.
We apply the benchmark’s paired pre/post comparisons as provided by the official evaluator.
Complete Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 results are reported in Appendix G.2 .
blocks.zh:
基准衡量助理行为如何因重叠事件而改变.
其官方评价包括反应-行为分布,停站和反应延迟,以及事件前后语音特征的变化,包括UTMOSv2(Baba等,2024年),发声率,发声统计,强度统计等.
对于基于LLM的行为分类,我们使用gpt-5.6-luna的推理被禁用,同时保留了官方的评价快取.
我们采用官方评价者提供的基准对前后的比较。
附录G.2报告了完整的 " 双倍 " v1.5结果。

blocks.en: E.2 General Spoken-Language Benchmarks
blocks.zh: E.2 一般语法基准

blocks.en:
Full-duplex interaction metrics test whether DiffuPlex preserves conversational behavior, but do not establish whether future prediction changes the backbone’s general response capability.
We therefore additionally evaluate VoiceBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and OpenAudioBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) under a common single-turn protocol.
VoiceBench contains 7,783 examples from nine tasks: AlpacaEval (636), CommonEval (200), WildVoice (1,000), SD-QA with the U.S. accent split (553), OpenBookQA (455), MMSU (3,074), BBH (1,000), IFEval (345), and AdvBench (520).
We exclude the 46-example MT-Bench subset because it requires a multi-turn evaluation protocol that does not match the single-turn setting used here.
For OpenAudioBench, we evaluate the four English subsets, Llama Questions (300), Web Questions (1,000), TriviaQA (1,000), and AlpacaEval (199), yielding 2,499 examples.
We exclude the remaining Reasoning QA subset, which is released in Chinese, because the backbone and our speech-to-speech transcription pipeline are English-only.
blocks.zh:
Full-duplex交互度量标准测试DiffuPlex是否保留了对话行为,但不确定未来的预测是否改变骨干的一般反应能力.
因此,我们还根据共同的一回合协议,对Voice Bench(Chen等,2026年)和OpenAudio Bench(Li等,2025年b)进行评价。
Voice Bench包含了来自9个任务的7,783个例子:AlpacaEval(636个),CommonEval(200个),WildVoice(1000个),美国口音分拆的SD-QA(553个),OpenBookQA(455个),MMSU(3,074个),BBH(1000个),IFEval(345个)和Adv Bench(520个).
我们排除了46-例 MT-Bench 子集,因为它需要一个与这里使用的单回合设置不相匹配的多回合评价协议.
就OpenAudio Bench而言,我们评价了四个英文子集,即Llama Questions(300),Web Questions (1,000),TriviaQA (1,000),和AlpacaEval (199),产生了2,499个例子.
我们排除了其余的"理性QA"子集,该子集以中文发布,因为骨干和我们的语音对语音的转录管道只有英语.

blocks.en:
Both benchmarks assume that the complete spoken instruction is received before response generation begins.
We adapt them to the continuously running full-duplex backbone following the Moshi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) evaluation pipeline in VoiceBench.
While the instruction waveform is streamed normally through Mimi, the assistant output streams are constrained to silence, and free generation begins immediately after the final instruction frame.
This prevents incidental full-duplex behavior, such as backchannels produced during the question, from being interpreted as part of the benchmark answer while leaving the subsequent response unconstrained.
Because the backbone does not emit an EOS event for spoken generation, we append a 163.84s silent user tail, corresponding to 2,048 interaction frames, after each instruction.
Once assistant speech has begun, generation terminates after 8.0s of continuous assistant silence; if this condition is never reached, generation ends at the end of the appended tail.
The silence counter begins only after the instruction has finished.
Both benchmarks use the conversational system prompt You enjoy having a good conversation. and the sampling configuration in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh:
两项基准都假定,完整的口头指导是在答复生成开始之前收到的。
我们让他们适应在Voice Bench的Moshi(Défossez等,2024年)评价管道之后不断运行的全方位骨干。
虽然指令波形通常通过米米来流出,但助理输出流却被限制于沉默,自由生成在最终指令框后立即开始.
这防止了附带的全复通行为,比如在提问期间产生的后道被解释为基准答案的一部分,同时使后续的响应不受限制.
由于主干不会为口语生成出一个EOS事件,我们附加一个163.84s的无声用户尾巴,对应每个指令后2,048个交互帧.
一旦助理语音开始,在连续的助理沉默8.0s后,生成终止;如果这个条件从未达到,生成结束于后附尾.
沉默计数器只在指令完成后才开始.
两个基准都使用对话系统即时 你喜欢好好的谈话 附录D.3中的取样配置。

blocks.en:
We evaluate both the model’s native text output and the speech ultimately presented to the user.
For speech-to-text (s → \rightarrow t), we directly score the assistant text stream from the free-generation region after removing the backbone’s special text tokens, without using ASR.
For speech-to-speech (s → \rightarrow s), we remove the instruction-aligned prefix from the generated assistant audio, transcribe the remaining speech with nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 , and apply the original benchmark scorers to the resulting transcription.
For judge-based tasks, we use gpt-5.6-luna with reasoning disabled while retaining the official task prompts and aggregation procedures.
Complete per-task results for both output modalities are reported in Appendix G.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们既评价模型的原生文本输出,又评价最终提交给用户的演讲。
对于语音对文本(s ~\rightarrow t),在删除了主干部分的特殊文本符后,我们直接从自由生成区域给助理文本流打分,而不用ASR.
对于语音对语音(s →\rightarrow s),我们从生成的助理音频中去掉指令相通的前缀,用nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2将剩余的语音转录,并将原始的基准分数对产生的转录应用.
对于法官任务,我们使用gpt-5.6-luna,其推理被禁用,同时保留官方任务提示和汇总程序.
附录G.3报告了两种产出模式的每项任务结果。

blocks.en: E.3 Runtime Measurement
blocks.zh: E.3 运行时间测量

blocks.en:
We measure runtime on a fixed subset of 60 Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 clips using a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.
The subset contains 15 examples from each of the four interaction categories.
Within each category, we select examples to cover the range of assistant-silence fractions observed under the autoregressive personaplex-rl-seamless reference; for pause handling, we additionally include examples from both the Candor and synthetic sources.
This subset is selected once and reused unchanged for every system, so the runtime evaluation does not depend on each system’s own speaking behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们使用单一的NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU来测量60个Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0片段的固定子集上的运行时间.
该子集包含四个互动类别中每个类别的15个实例.
在每个类别中,我们选择例子,以涵盖在自递性人称-rl-无缝引用下观察到的辅助-静脉分数范围;关于暂停处理,我们额外包括来自Candor和合成来源的例子。
此子集被选中一次, 并且对每个系统都不加修改的重复使用, 因此运行时间评价并不取决于每个系统自身的演讲行为 。

blocks.en:
We distinguish three notions of runtime. Streaming wall time measures elapsed time through the deployment-path streaming loop and therefore includes Python and CPU control, synchronization, and GPU execution. E2E GPU time accumulates GPU execution for the complete streaming inference pipeline, including the speech codec path. Core LM time measures GPU execution of the language-model generation core alone.
All speedups are computed relative to the autoregressive personaplex-rl-seamless reference under the same measurement path, excluding file writing, ASR, judging, and benchmark scoring.
To separate how often the temporal backbone runs from the cost of each wake, we define the number of interaction frames advanced per backbone wake as c = total interaction frames total backbone wakes . c=\frac{\text{total interaction frames}}{\text{total backbone wakes}}. (20) The relative Core LM time per wake reported in Table 2 is the average Core LM time per backbone wake normalized by the autoregressive reference.
This distinction is important because a DiffuPlex wake processes a future block and can therefore be more expensive than a single autoregressive wake, while still reducing total Core LM time by invoking the backbone less frequently.
blocks.zh:
我们分辨了三种运行时间的概念。 流墙时间测量通过部署路径流出回路经过时间,因此包括了Python和CPU控制,同步和GPU执行. E2E GPU时间累积了GPU执行,用于完整的流出推论管道,包括语音编码路径. Core LM时间单独衡量语言模型生成核心的GPU执行.
所有速度都是根据同一测量路径下的自递性人-rl-无缝参照计算,不包括文件编写、ASR、判断和基准分数。
为了区分时间主干线运行频率与每次钟点的成本,我们将每个主干线钟点的高级交互帧数定义为c=总交互帧总主干线钟. c- frac\ text{ 完全交互框架\ text{ 完全主干线唤醒了\ 。 (20) 表2中报告的每分钟相对核心LM时间是每分钟平均核心LM时间因自递性参考而正常化。
这种区分很重要,因为DiffuPlex警钟会处理一个未来的块,因此可能比一个自旋后钟更昂贵,同时通过较少地使用骨干来减少核心LM的总时间.

blocks.en:
GPU totals are measured with CUDA timing while avoiding unnecessary synchronization.
Wake-frame latency is measured separately on the streaming critical path, with synchronization when the temporal backbone is invoked, and the initial CUDA graph capture is excluded.
We report the p99 wake-frame latency together with the fraction
whose wall-clock latency exceeds 80ms, the duration of one interaction frame.
For the deferred-execution baselines in Appendix D.4 , controller decisions are computed causally in advance and replayed during the timed generation loop so that controller execution does not perturb GPU timing. Silero and Smart Turn inference is therefore excluded from streaming wall time and measured separately.
The primary Smart Turn pipeline requires approximately 13.90ms of controller processing per interaction second in our setup, with approximately 80% of this time spent in the continuously running Silero frontend.
The runtime comparison therefore separates backbone streaming cost from this additional CPU-side controller computation.
Runtime measurements for the main systems are reported in
Table 2 , with deferred-execution results
in Appendix G.4 .

GPU总和用CUDA计时来测量,同时避免不必要的同步.
Wake-frame latientency在流出的关键路径上分别测量出,在使用时间主干时同步,初始CUDA图捕捉被排除在外.
我们报告P99的警钟 和分数

对于附录 D.4 中的延期执行基线,控制器决定是预先因果计算,并在定时生成回路中重放,以便控制器执行不会干扰GPU的计时. 因此,Silero和Smart Turn的推论被排除在流墙时间之外,并分别计量.

blocks.en: E.4 Statistical Testing
blocks.zh: E.4 统计测试

blocks.en: For Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0, we compare DiffuPlex- Listen and DiffuPlex- Speak separately with the autoregressive personaplex-rl-seamless backbone using paired statistical tests over ten interaction metrics per policy: the two pause-handling TORs; backchannel TOR, frequency, and JSD; smooth-turn TOR and latency; and interruption TOR, response score, and latency, yielding 20 comparisons in total. We use the exact McNemar test for binary clip-level outcomes, including TOR, and a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired continuous or ordinal measurements. We jointly correct the resulting 20 tests using the Holm procedure and report both unadjusted and Holm-adjusted results in Appendix G.1 . A non-significant result after correction is interpreted only as an absence of detected evidence of a difference under these tests, not as evidence of formal equivalence.
blocks.zh: 对于Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0,我们分别将DiffuPlex-聆听和DiffuPlex-说话与自递性人性化-rl-seam-无缝主干网进行比较,使用对接统计测试,每个策略在10个互动度量上进行:两个暂停处理TOR;后通道TOR,频率,和JSD;平滑转盘和纬度;中断TOR,响应分数和纬度,得出总共20个比较. 我们使用精确的McNemar测试二进制剪接级结果,包括TOR,以及双侧的Wilcoxon签名级测试,对成对连续或正数测量. 我们利用霍尔姆程序共同纠正了由此产生的20项试验,并在附录G.1中报告了未经调整和霍尔姆调整的结果。 更正后的非重大结果仅被解释为没有检测到的这些试验下差异的证据,而不是形式等同的证据。

blocks.en:
We conduct two complementary human evaluations on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) using user-interruption examples from Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0.
Naturalness mean opinion score (NMOS) evaluates only the assistant speech following the interruption, whereas dialog mean opinion score (DMOS) evaluates the complete interaction, including how the assistant yields to the interruption and resumes afterward.
For each assignment, outputs from the compared systems correspond to the same underlying interaction, with presentation order randomized and model identities hidden.
blocks.zh:
我们利用来自Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0的用户干扰实例,对亚马逊机械特克(MTurk)进行了两次人类互补评价.
Naturalness指意见分数(NMOS)只评价中断后助理语音,而"对话"指意见分数(DMOS)则评价完整的交互,包括助理如何对中断进行回放.
对于每一项任务,比较系统的产出都对应相同的基本互动,演示顺序随机排列并隐藏模型身份.

blocks.en:
For NMOS, evaluators hear only the assistant response following the interruption and answer, “How would you rate the overall speech quality and naturalness?”, on a five-point scale from 1 ( Very poor ) to 5 ( Excellent ).
They are instructed to judge speech quality and naturalness, including pronunciation, prosody, rhythm, and audio artifacts, while ignoring speaker identity, accent, speaking style, and personal voice preference.
Before rating, workers are provided with fixed reference recordings illustrating approximate scores of 5, 3, and 1 for scale calibration.
Each assignment includes two attention checks: an intentionally silent recording and a known score-1 calibration item, both of which must receive a score of 1.
Assignments that fail either check are discarded and recollected from a new worker.
The interface requires every recording to be played in full before submission.
The final NMOS analysis contains 200 valid assignments from 120 workers.

对NMOS来说,评价人员只听到助理在中断后的反应,并回答“你如何评定总体的语音质量和自然性?” 从1分(非常差)到5分(极好),分5分。
他们奉命判断语音的质量和自然性,包括发音,发音,节奏,和音频文物,而忽略了扬声器的身份,口音,说话风格,和个人语音偏好.
在评分前,向工人提供固定的参考记录,说明大约5分、3分和1分的尺度校准。
每项任务包括两次注意检查:一次是故意无声录制,一次是已知的分数一分校正项目,两者都必须得到一分.
任何一次检查失败的任务都会被放弃,从新工人那里收回。
界面要求每张录音在提交前全部播放.
最后的NMOS分析包含120名工人的200个有效任务.

blocks.en:
For DMOS, evaluators hear the complete interaction and answer, “How natural is the conversational flow and interruption handling?”, on a five-point scale from 1 ( Very unnatural ) to 5 ( Very natural ).
They are instructed to judge whether the assistant yields at an appropriate time, avoids talking over the user, waits while the user is speaking, resumes appropriately, and produces a response that fits the user’s continued or revised request.
Because DMOS is intended to isolate interaction behavior, evaluators are explicitly instructed to ignore acoustic quality, including synthesis artifacts, timbre, speaker identity, accent, and pronunciation.
Each assignment contains one attention-check interaction with the normal user channel but a completely silent assistant channel, which must receive a score of 1.
Assignments that fail this check are discarded and recollected from a new worker.
The interface requires every recording to be played in full before submission.
The final DMOS analysis contains 180 valid assignments from 84 workers.

Table 5 reports the 20 paired Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 comparisons defined in Appendix E.4 .
Each comparison uses the same clips for the autoregressive backbone and DiffuPlex, so the test asks whether the two systems behave differently on matched examples rather than comparing independent sets of outputs.
For binary outcomes such as TOR, we use the exact McNemar test, which examines how often the two systems disagree on the same clips.
For continuous or ordinal quantities such as latency, backchannel frequency, JSD, and interruption score, we use the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, which compares the paired differences across clips without assuming that those differences are normally distributed.
The raw p p -value measures the evidence for a difference in each individual comparison, while the Holm-adjusted p p -value additionally accounts for testing 20 hypotheses jointly.
We use the adjusted values when determining statistical significance.
None of the 20 comparisons remains significant after Holm correction, so these tests do not detect a statistically significant difference between DiffuPlex and the autoregressive backbone on any evaluated metric.
This should not be interpreted as evidence that the systems are formally equivalent.

blocks.en: H.1 Training Objective and Architecture
blocks.zh: H.1 培训目标和结构

blocks.en:
We first vary components that determine how the masked future predictor is learned.
The default model freezes personaplex-rl-seamless , applies LoRA only for lookaheads h ≥ 2 h\geq 2 , and distills the clean autoregressive distributions into the masked path.
We compare this model with several changes to the training objective and backbone. No gate applies the learned adapters at every lookahead, including h = 1 h=1 , removing the structural guarantee that the ordinary next-frame path uses the original frozen backbone. CE only replaces the teacher distributions for the masked path with hard data targets and removes the three-way text-state distillation term.
We additionally remove either the token-level text KL or the three-way PAD/EPAD/lexical KL while retaining the remaining distillation terms, and train the same DiffuPlex adaptation on the original PersonaPlex backbone rather than the post-trained personaplex-rl-seamless checkpoint.
Table 11 reports the resulting efficiency and interaction metrics for both inference policies.

The future gate primarily protects the original next-frame path.
Without it, the model still reduces backbone wakes, but turn-taking TOR changes from 1.000 1.000 to .983 .983 for Listen and .975 .975 for Speak , with corresponding turn latencies of .202 .202 s and .253 .253 s.
The gate therefore provides a structural separation between the unchanged autoregressive prediction at h = 1 h=1 and the learned masked-future behavior at deeper lookaheads.
Replacing teacher distillation with hard-target cross-entropy also shortens the usable future horizon: c c decreases from 1.91 1.91 to 1.76 1.76 for Listen and from 2.23 2.23 to 2.07 2.07 for Speak .
The interaction changes are not uniform across metrics, but the reduced advancement and larger Listen interruption latency ( .512 .512 s versus .329 .329 s) are consistent with a benefit from matching the backbone distribution rather than relying only on hard future targets.
Removing either text KL term produces mixed changes across the interaction metrics.
Both ablations reduce the interruption Judge score for both policies, with the largest drop from 4.357 4.357 to 4.202 4.202 when removing the token-level text KL for Speak .
The final model retains both text KL terms.

We next vary three training-scale axes: the maximum future block used during training, LoRA rank, and the number of optimization steps.
The default uses W = 16 W=16 , rank 128, and 526 optimization steps.
For the training-horizon variants, we use the same W W at inference as during training, yielding matched → 8 8\!\rightarrow\!8 and → 32 32\!\rightarrow\!32 settings; train-inference horizon mismatch is examined separately in Appendix H.3 .
To examine the effect of training exposure, the 263-step and 1,052-step variants use schedules whose learning-rate decay is defined to terminate at their respective final steps, rather than taking intermediate checkpoints from a longer run.
Table 12 reports the resulting efficiency and interaction metrics.
Across the rank and training-duration sweeps, the number of frames advanced per wake remains relatively stable, while individual interaction metrics vary in both directions.
Increasing LoRA rank from 128 to 512 or doubling training from 526 to 1,052 steps does not yield a consistent improvement, whereas rank 32 retains a similar c c but shifts turn-taking behavior.

The matched-horizon comparison shows a different trade-off.
Training and inference with W = 8 W=8 yields similar advancement but larger shifts on several interaction metrics, including Speak backchannel TOR and turn latency.
Increasing both training and inference horizons to W = 32 W=32 likewise provides little additional advancement, while the larger proposed block increases per-wake LM cost and reduces the pooled LM speedup.
The default W = 16 W=16 setting lies between these two trade-offs.
